name: ERP Integration Suite
description: End-to-end ERP integration with third-party platforms
details: The ERP Integration Suite provides a comprehensive set of APIs and middleware connectors that allow seamless data exchange between your existing ERP system (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) and third-party platforms including e-commerce, logistics, and CRM. Features include real-time sync, error recovery, audit trails, and a no-code mapping interface. Supports REST, SOAP, and EDI protocols. SLA-backed uptime of 99.9%.

name: Cloud Data Warehouse
description: Managed cloud data warehouse with BI dashboard
details: A fully managed cloud data warehouse solution built on columnar storage technology. Supports petabyte-scale analytics with sub-second query performance. Comes with a built-in BI dashboard builder, pre-built connectors for 50+ data sources, scheduled data refresh, role-based access control, and automated backup. Available on AWS, Azure, and GCP. White-labelled reporting module included.

name: CRM Pro
description: Customer relationship management platform for SMEs
details: CRM Pro is a sales-focused CRM designed for SMEs. It includes lead management, contact management, pipeline tracking, email integration (Gmail/Outlook), automated follow-up sequences, sales forecasting, and a mobile app. Integrates with WhatsApp Business API for customer communication. Supports unlimited contacts on the Enterprise tier. Custom fields, workflows, and reports are available.

name: Inventory Management System
description: Real-time inventory tracking and warehouse management
details: The Inventory Management System (IMS) provides real-time visibility into stock levels across multiple warehouses. Features include barcode/QR scanning via mobile, automatic reorder point alerts, batch/lot tracking, expiry date management, supplier purchase orders, FIFO/LIFO/FEFO costing methods, and integration with popular e-commerce platforms. Comes with a WMS module for bin-level tracking.

name: HR & Payroll
description: Human resources and payroll management solution
details: Complete HR and payroll management covering employee onboarding, attendance tracking (biometric/mobile), leave management, performance appraisal cycles, payroll processing with tax compliance (BD), salary disbursement via bank API, employee self-service portal, and HR analytics dashboard. Compliant with Bangladesh Labor Law 2006 and tax regulations.
